# Sudoku Project Instructions

## Project
This is a Python Flask Sudoku web application.

## Code Quality
- Write clean and readable code.
- Use meaningful names.
- Use small reusable functions.
- Avoid unnecessary duplicate code.
- Keep game logic separate from Flask routes and frontend code.
- Handle errors safely.
- Do not add unnecessary libraries.

## Sudoku Requirements
- Use a 9x9 Sudoku board.
- Every row, column, and 3x3 box must contain numbers 1-9 without repetition.
- Every generated puzzle must have exactly one solution.
- Prefilled cells must be locked.
- Support Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulties.

## Required Features
- Difficulty selector.
- Hint button.
- Check button.
- Immediate invalid-entry feedback.
- Completion message.
- Timer.
- Top 10 scoreboard.
- Player name, time, difficulty, and hints used.
- localStorage persistence.
- Dark mode.
- Responsive desktop and mobile design.
- Alternating colors for 3x3 boxes.

## Testing
- Set up testing before refactoring.
- Run tests before and after major changes.
- Keep existing tests passing.
- Add tests for important new features.

## Copilot Workflow
- Inspect existing code before making major changes.
- Make focused changes.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Explain important changes.
- Evaluate Copilot suggestions before accepting them.
- Reject unnecessary or incorrect suggestions.

## Documentation
- Keep README.md updated.
- Include setup and test commands.
